seven_slots.Objects: Arbitrary total:Nat->Real and fixed real c.
seven_slots.Quantifiers: For every total and c, equivalence of two atTop assertions.
seven_slots.Assumptions: No sign, monotonicity, A0=0, c=0, stochastic or convergence premise.
seven_slots.Terminal: Centered total little-o(T) iff average total minus c tends to zero.
seven_slots.Constants/normalization: Real-cast natural denominator; signed centered residual; little-o controls magnitude.
seven_slots.Information structure: No algorithm or probability model is asserted.
seven_slots.Boundary/delta: Use eventual T>0; at T0 quotient-minus-c=-c while residual=A0. No pointwise identity at zero is required.

S001.actual_body_finding: Actual eventually_gt_atTop produces nonzero real T. normalized_excess supplies eventual quotient equality; isLittleO_iff_tendsto and tendsto_congr prove the iff. No A0/c restriction or assumed convergence.

seven_slots.Objects: Arbitrary measurable Omega and Seed, probability mu, one infinite real target process and one seed-history policy.
seven_slots.Quantifiers: Universal data/hypotheses then let-defined actual prediction; all-T nonnegativity and two iff statements.
seven_slots.Assumptions: Measurable same-law a.s.unit targets, joint IID, measurable seed independent of WHOLE stream, jointly measurable policy feasible for every seed on legal histories only.
seven_slots.Terminal: Nonnegative expected fixed regret; little-o iff average loss minus variance tends0 iff average integrated squared deviation from population mean tends0. It does not assert arbitrary-policy convergence.
seven_slots.Constants/normalization: Unnormalized expected cumulative loss minus min of expected fixed loss; denominator T in limits, variance and mean of Y0.
seven_slots.Information structure: Actual strict-past tuple plus private tape, same process/policy across horizons; no current Yt or law oracle input.
seven_slots.Boundary/delta: T0 lower bound valid; normalized sequences may differ at T0. Explicit private-seed model does not represent every kernel/completed-information/AE-factorized strategy.

S002.actual_body_finding: Actual seeded causal expectedFixed_excess supplies both finite nonnegativity and MSE sum; expectedFixedMinimum_eq_variance and S001 prove first iff; the second uses eventual positive-horizon division of the produced equality. Same let-bound prediction throughout; no arbitrary-policy success assertion.

seven_slots.Objects: Same-law a.s.unit measurable process and actual initial-half meanPredict on its histories.
seven_slots.Quantifiers: Every such process and every natural T>0.
seven_slots.Assumptions: Probability, all-time measurability/same-law/a.s.support; NO independence premise.
seven_slots.Terminal: One-sided expected fixed regret <=4+4logT, a derived integrated application of Theorem1.3.
seven_slots.Constants/normalization: Natural logarithm, positive real-cast horizon, unnormalized signed excess; initial output1/2.
seven_slots.Information structure: Strict past only; population mean is analysis comparator, not learner input; no horizon-dependent rerun.
seven_slots.Boundary/delta: No T0 formula assertion or nonnegativity without IID. Must derive integrability and use empirical minimum <= population-comparator loss before integration; no E/min swap.

S003.actual_body_finding: AE-all support is assembled, prediction and target MemLp2 are genuinely derived, then both finite sums are integrable. Pathwise theorem_1_3 and empiricalMean_minimizes give loss-minus-fixed-population-mean upper in the correct inequality direction. integral_mono_ae/integral_sub are applied only after integrability. Same-law decomposition and actual fixed minimum turn this into the frozen endpoint without independence or exchanging min and expectation.

seven_slots.Objects: Joint-IID version of S003 and same actual meanPredict.
seven_slots.Quantifiers: For every fixed infinite process, ordinary normalized zero limit AND little-o atTop.
seven_slots.Assumptions: Add joint independence to measurable same-law probability/a.s.support; no assumed convergence.
seven_slots.Terminal: Actual algorithm success for expected fixed regret, not an equivalence alone.
seven_slots.Constants/normalization: Division by real T, zero ordinary limit and magnitude little-o; upper rate follows from 4+4logT.
seven_slots.Information structure: Same strict-past unknown-law learner, source round1=Lean0; seed/general strategy not asserted.
seven_slots.Boundary/delta: Finite initial T0 irrelevant to limits; IID lower bound and positive-horizon upper are both needed. No a.s./high-probability/minimax or full-source strategy-class closure.

S004.actual_body_finding: Actual meanPredict_expectedFixed_excess supplies nonnegative lower; actual S003 supplies eventual upper after division. Existing real inverse/log-over-x limits compose with Nat.cast; squeeze_zero gives ordinary normalized convergence. S001 is a genuine second consumer at c=0, proving little-o. Neither limit is assumed; no horizon-dependent learner.

canary_verdict: accepted: actual positive success, persistent-seed non-success, dependent negative excess, T0 and nonzero A0/c fixtures; fourteen named proofs/two definitions

future_integration_scope_verdict.conditions: Exact own append/import/field scope only; immutable snapshots for old raw receipt bindings before live mutation; actual suffix semantics/current reader and all combined gates reviewed later; no native or delivery completion claim.

required_reader_corrections.requirement: Display source equations (1.1) and (1.2) and Theorem 1.3 with source round 1 = Lean time 0; label S001 as a generic adapter and S003/S004 as derived applications, not new numbered source results.
Keep minimization over the expected loss of one fixed comparator outside expectation; explain the feasible population mean and do not substitute expected hindsight minimum.

State one infinite probability process with measurable same-law a.s. [0,1] targets; S002/S004 require joint IID, whereas S003 does not; derive integrability rather than strengthen to pointwise support.

For S002 state seed independence from the whole target stream, joint measurability, every-seed feasibility only on legal strict-past histories, and the actual composed prediction; equivalences do not make every policy successful.
Show the actual unknown-law meanPredict with initial 1/2 and strict-past empirical mean; population mean is a proof comparator, not algorithm input, and horizons do not select different learners.
Distinguish ordinary expected normalized zero convergence and magnitude little-o from adversarial eventual-upper-epsilon NoRegret; state eventual T>0 and the possible generic T0 discrepancy.

Present complete exact headers and definitions, a displayed proof explanation and actual compiled dependencies only when available; preserve existing registry IDs/URLs/hashes and verify current formulas/pixels after applicable combined gates.

Keep full randomization/kernel/completed-information/AE-factorization coverage, five old module audits, original sixteen source objects with null proof total, full C1/C2, Chapters3–16 and necessary appendices required; no chapter/Goal/main/live completion.
